source: After the defeat of the two golems, the entire ruin complex fell suspiciously silent.
target: Post cladem duorum golemorum, totus complexus ruinarum in silentium suspicuum cecidit.

source: There were no roars in the distance, nor was the ceiling shaking and raining dust down on Sam.
target: Non erant rugitus in longinquo, nec tectum tremens pulverem super Sam iaciebat.

source: The only thing he could hear was an almost silent noise of water dripping somewhere, the happy panting of Lucky, and his own ragged breath.
target: Unum solum, quod audire poterat, fuit quasi tacitus sonus aquae alicubi stillantis, halitus laetus Lucky, et proprius anhelitus laceratus.

source: With a negligent wave of his hand and a small exertion of his will, Sam retrieved the two marble‑sized items remaining from his enemies.
target: Negligenter manu iactu et parvo impendio voluntatis, Sam duo obiecta marmori magnitudinem habentia ab hostibus reliqua recuperavit.

source: Then he plopped unceremoniously on the ground and leaned back, resting on his hands while closing his eyes in relief.
target: Deinde in terram sine caerimonia cecidit et recubuit, manibus innixus dum oculos solacio clauserat.

source: He mentally went over the facts and experiences so far in the ruin.
target: Animo, res atque experientias usque ad hanc ruinam meditatus est.

source: “Three golems, three items,” he mused, eyes still closed and Lucky snuggling up to him.
target: “Tres golemorum, tres obiecta,” meditatus est, oculis adhuc clausis atque Lucky sibi appropinquans.

source: “At this level, that’s the most I can expect. Probably still have a boss to fight, but the three marbles are probably keys to something…”
target: “Ad hoc gradu, id maxime exspectare possum. Fortasse adhuc habebo principem pugnandum, sed tres marmora fortasse claves ad aliquid sunt...”

source: Opening his eyes, Sam took a quick stock of the situation.
target: Oculos aperiens, Sam celeriter condicionem perpendit.

source: With the help of his Earth Wall spell he quickly raised a minimal cover in the corner of the room for setting up his tent.
target: Per auxilium incantationis “Murus Terrae,” celeriter parvum tegmen in angulo cubiculi ad tabernaculum instituendum erexit.

source: When finished with all that, he logged out for a brief rest, meal, and bathroom break.
target: Post omnia finita, ex systemate discessit ad breve quietem, cibum, et latrinam intermissam.

source: Returning to the game, Sam sat down in front of his tent with Lucky, retrieved his rations and also set up Lucky’s food.
target: Ad ludum rediens, Sam ante tabernaculum cum Lucky consedit, suas mensas cibarias recuperavit et etiam cibum Lucky praeparavit.

source: He watched for a moment, smiling gently, as Lucky enthusiastically began to scarf down his treat.
target: Aliquantulum observavit, leniter subridentes, dum Lucky alacriter deliciis suis vorare inciperet.

source: Then Sam also began to gnaw on his rations, ignoring their taste, while opening his status screen.
target: Tum Sam quoque cibos suos mordere coepit, eos gustum neglegens, dum tabulam status suam aperiebat.

source: Thankfully, his notifications were still set to adaptive, so nothing bothered him during his fight in the ruins, but it was time for his brain to feel the good stuff watching all the numbers go up.
target: Gratias deo, notitiae eius adhuc ad rationem accommodatae erant, itaque nihil eum occupabat in pugna inter ruinas, sed tempus erat ut mens eius laeta bona sentiret dum omnes numeri augerentur.

source: He first navigated to Lucky’s screen, wanting to see what the new skill his wolf companion used was.
target: Primum scrinium Lucky versa est, cupiens videre qua esset nova peritia quam comes lupus eius adhibebat.

source: [Thanks to taking care and fighting in sync with your companion, your skill, Spirit Link has reached Level 15!]
target: [Gratias curae et synchroniae certandi cum socio tuo, peritia tua “Vinculum Spirituum” ad Gradum 15 pervenit!]

source: [Your companion, Lucky, has reached Level 15!]
target: [Socius tuus, Lucky, ad Gradum 15 pervenit!]

source: [Lucky has gained a new skill, Shadow Jump!]
target: [Lucky novam peritiam adeptus est, “Saltus Umbrarum!”]

source: [Shadow Jump: Level 0/20 (0%) (Active) The wolf gains the ability to dive into your shadow and emerge from a different shadow. Range: 100 meters. Cooldown: 120 seconds.]
target: [Saltus Umbrarum: Gradus 0/20 (0%) (Activa) Lupus facultatem accipit ut in umbram tuam mergatur et ex alio umbra emerga. Spatium: 100 metra. Tempus recuperationis: 120 secundae.]

source: He reread the skill a few times, but couldn’t help but be impressed.
target: Peritiam iterum aliquoties lectus est, sed non potuit non esse admiratus.

source: The skill was something he could see being useful and powerful.
target: Peritia videbatur utilis atque valida.

source: More importantly, it was a skill that could be improved with time.
target: Maxime quidem, peritia erat quam tempore emendari possit.

source: Most pets and companions belonged to people who weren't using minion or pet‐specific skills.
target: Plurima animalia domestica et comites ad eos pertinebant qui peritias proprias “minion” aut “pet” speciales non adhibebant.

source: Thus, those pets gained skills that couldn't be leveled up.
target: Ita, illis animalibus artes adeptae sunt quarum gradus augeri non poterant.

source: Getting a skill that could advance was incredibly lucky…
target: Acquirere peritiam quae progredi posset, incredibiliter felix erat…

source: After celebrating the skill with a little playtime, he returned his attention to his own status screen.
target: Postquam peritiam cum parvo ludo celebravit, animum suum ad proprium tabulam status redemit.

source: While one of his hands absentmindedly was going through Lucky’s silken fur, to the obvious pleasure of the wolf.
target: Dum una ex manibus eius inconsulte per pilum sericum Lucky percurrit, ad lupum manifeste delectans.

source: [Congratulations! You’ve leveled up!]
target: [Gratulor! Gradum attigisti!]

source: [You’re now Level 22!]
target: [Nunc Gradus tuus est 22!]

source: [Gained 4 unassigned attribute points!]
target: [Quattuor puncta attributa, nondum distributa, adeptus es!]

source: [Gained 1 MAG point of extensive and creative use of your mana!]
target: [Unum punctum MAG, usus amplo et creativo mana tuae, adeptus es!]

source: [Gained +1 AGI for the impressive display of speed!]
target: [Acquisitum est +1 AGI propter rapiditatis ostentationem praeclaram!]

source: He was a little disappointed at not getting an extra stat point after his fight, but it was pretty obvious to him that even if he hadn't used tricks to defeat the monster, he would have been able to win.
target: Paululum contristatus erat quod extra punctum statum post pugnam non adeptus esset, sed sibi patebat quod, etiam si dolis ad monstrum vincendum non usus fuisset, victor esse potuisset.

source: Grumbling a little, he added the remaining points to STR, DEX, VIT and PER.
target: Paulatim murmure, reliqua puncta ad STR, DEX, VIT et PER adiicivit.

source: Frowning at the disparity between his health and mana, Sam made up his mind that after he was finished with the quest here, he would take some time and shore up his weakness.
target: Cernens inaequalitatem inter salutem et manam suam, Sam constituit post hanc inquisitionem tempus capere atque infirmitatem suam corroborare.

source: There were some basic skills that he would be able to get with little to no trouble.
target: Erant quaedam peritiae fundamentalia quas parvo labore assequi posset.

source: Next, he started reviewing the level‑ups of his skills.
target: Deinde, incrementa peritiarum suarum recensere incipiebat.

source: [Advanced Mana Control is now Level 17!]
target: [Moderatio Manae Provecta nunc Gradus 17 est!]

source: [Stable Mana Control is now Level 7!]
target: [Moderatio Manae Stabilis nunc Gradus 7 est!]

source: [Mana Shield reached Level 30!]
target: [Scutum Manae ad Gradum 30 pervenit!]

source: [Controlled Mana Shield reached Level 8!]
target: [Scutum Manae Moderatum ad Gradum 8 pervenit!]

source: [Sustained Mana Shield reached level 6!]
target: [Scutum Manae Sustentatum ad Gradum 6 pervenit!]

source: [Thanks to sustaining your Mana Shield through several attacks that covered your entire body, you gain the sub‑skill Layered Mana Shield!]
target: [Gratias quod per plures impetus totum corpus teum tegendum scutum Manae sustinuisse, subperitiam “Scutum Manae Stratum” adeptus es!]

source: [Layered Mana Shield: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Allows you to layer your Mana Shield. For every level in the skill, you can create one extra layer over your original Mana Shield. Each layer costs 10% more to create and maintain. The current number of extra layers that can be created: 1. Upon reaching the maximum number of layers (7) there is a possibility to upgrade this sub‑skill into a full skill.]
target: [Scutum Manae Stratum: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Permittit tibi scutum Manae in strata disponere. Pro unoquoque gradu in peritia, unum stratum additum supra scutum originale creare potes. Quisque stratum creationem et sustentationem decem centesimas plus onerat. Numerus currentis stratorum additorum qui creari possunt: 1. Cum ad maximum numerum stratorum (7) pervenitur, subperitia in plenam peritiam converteri potest!]

source: Sam stared at his newest sub‑skill and let out a full belly laugh.
target: Sam subperitiam novissimam aspexit et plenam risum ventricosum edidit.

source: One of the most coveted skills by those who had the chance to learn Mana Shield.
target: Una ex peritiis maxime expetendis a iis qui occasionem didicerunt Scutum Manae fuit.

source: Mana Armor, at its base level, was a skill that you could layer.
target: Armatura Manae, in gradu suo basali, erat peritia quae in strata disponi poterat.

source: Though, arguably, a novice mage wouldn’t be able to sustain it.
target: Attamen, dici potest, ne novitius magus eam sustinere posset.

source: Also, another negative aspect of that skill was that it only allowed layering up to three layers and the cost of that doubled every layer.
target: Praeterea, alius aspectus malus eius peritiae erat quod solum usque ad tres strata disponere licebat, et onus cuiusque strati duplicabatur.

source: Compared that to an increase of 10% was rather generous…
target: Hoc comparatum ad incrementum decem centesimarum valde liberaliter videbatur…

source: [Light Ball is now Level 10!]
target: [Orbis Lucis nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Clean is now Level 10!]
target: [Puritas nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Earth Wall is now Level 10!]
target: [Murus Terrae nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Wind Blade is now Level 10!]
target: [Lamina Venti nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Thanks to making proper use of the spell, you learned Light Ball II!]
target: [Gratias recto usu incantationis, didicisti Orbis Lucis II!]

source: [Thanks to making proper use of the spell, you learned Clean II!]
target: [Gratias recto usu incantationis, didicisti Puritas II!]

source: [Thanks to making creative use of the spell, you learned Earth Wall II!]
target: [Gratias usui creativo incantationis, didicisti Murus Terrae II!]

source: [Thanks to making creative use of the spell, you learned Wind Blade II!]
target: [Gratias usui creativo incantationis, didicisti Lamina Venti II!]

source: [Thanks to using Wind Blade with your Mana Slash and Double Mana Slash, you created the spell Wind Flurry!]
target: [Gratias usu Lamina Venti cum Incisione Manae et Incisione Manae Duplex, creavisti incantationem “Fluctus Venti!”]

source: [Light Ball II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to conjure a ball of light to illuminate your surroundings. You have control over the movement and location of the conjured ball of light. You can increase and decrease its intensity, shape, and color.]
target: [Orbis Lucis II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te globum lucis evocare ad circumiecta tua illuminanda. Imperium habes de motu et loco globi lucis evocati. Eius intensitatem, figuram atque colorem augere atque minuere potes.]

source: [Clean II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to clean a selected surface. You can not only clean physical contaminations but also magical ones. Depends on the strength of the magical contamination. Above a certain level, Clean II only weakens it.]
target: [Puritas II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te superficiem electam purgare. Non solum contaminationes physicas purgare potes, sed etiam quasdam magicas. Vim contaminationis magicae pendet; supra certum gradum, Puritas II eam tantum debilitare potest.]

source: [Earth Wall II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to create a wall made of earth and stone. You have control over the strength, shape, and measurements of the wall. Allows you to strengthen the created wall with extra mana.]
target: [Murus Terrae II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te murum ex terra et lapide creare. Imperium habes de robore, figura et mensuris muri. Permittit murum creatum addito mana corroborare.]

source: [Wind Blade II: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to launch a blade of wind. The cutting power and speed of the blade are increased. You have increased control over its movement after creation.]
target: [Lamina Venti II: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te lamina venti iniri. Potentia secandi et celeritas laminae augentur; post creationem, melius imperium habes de eius motu.]

source: [Wind Flurry: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) A spell that allows you to release a flurry of wind blades aimed in one direction. The damage of the released Wind Blades depends on the Wind Blade spell and your mastery over it.]
target: [Fluctus Venti: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Incantatio quae sinit te seriem laminarum venti in unam partem dimittere. Damnum laminis venti dimissis pendet ex incantatione “Lamina Venti” atque tua peritia in ea.]

source: Sam nodded as he read the notification about the spells.
target: Sam annuit dum nuntiationem de incantationibus legerat.

source: They were very basic spells.
target: Erant incantationes valde fundamentales.

source: So it was not a surprise that with his Mana Control and usage, they would level up fast.
target: Ita non mirum erat quod, cum Moderatione Manae et usu eius, celeriter ascenderent.

source: Most spells went up to V before it became impossible to upgrade them.
target: Plurima incantationes ad Gradum V ascendebant antequam eas emendare fieri impossibile factum esset.

source: You could increase that limit by specializing.
target: Hunc terminum potes auget per studium speciale.

source: For example, in air and wind magic, thus allowing your Wind Blade to reach even X.
target: Exempli causa, in magia aeris et venti, ita ut lamina venti tua etiam ad Gradum X perveniret.

source: But for Sam, this was more than enough.
target: Sed pro Sam, hoc supra sufficienter erat.

source: For fun, he conjured a light ball in front of him and spoke a word.
target: Ad ludicrum, globum lucis ante se evocavit et unum verbum locutus est.

source: “Red.”
target: “Rubrum.”

source: The ball turned red.
target: Globus ruber factus est.

source: He smiled, then spent a few minutes playing around with the spell.
target: Subridens, paucos minutas incantatione ludens degit.

source: Earning himself a level in it and recording a video of Lucky chasing after the constantly color‑changing ball of light.
target: Sibi gradum in ea adeptus, et video recordans Lucky, qui globum lucis, colore constanter mutantem, insequebatur.

source: [Mage Sight is now Level 9!]
target: [Visus Magi nunc Gradus 9 est!]

source: [Efficient Mana Slash is now Level 3!]
target: [Incisio Manae Efficax nunc Gradus 3 est!]

source: [Double Mana Slash is now Level 2!]
target: [Incisio Manae Duplex nunc Gradus 2 est!]

source: [Congratulations, you successfully broke through with the skill, Mana Strike!]
target: [Gratulor, peritiam “Mana Strike” feliciter superavisti!]

source: [You gained the sub‑skill, Phasing Strike!]
target: [Subperitiam “Phasing Strike” adeptus es!]

source: [You learned the skill Extended Mana Strike!]
target: [Peritiam “Extended Mana Strike” didicisti!]

source: [Phasing Strike: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) Those strikes that you enhance with Mana Strike gain the ability to ignore 2% of armor per skill level.]
target: [Phasing Strike: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Ipsi ictus quos “Mana Strike” amplificas, facultatem habent ut 2% armorum pro quolibet gradu peritiae praetermittant.]

source: [Extended Mana Strike: Level 0/10 (0%) (Active) The mana you use to enhance your strikes allows you to extend your reach, be it with your own limbs or weapon. +10% range on your strikes per skill level.]
target: [Extended Mana Strike: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Activa) Mana, quam ad ictus augendos utaris, sinit ut tuam extensionem— sive membris tuis sive telum— auferas. +10% spatium ictuum tuorum pro quolibet gradu peritiae.]

source: Sam stared a moment at Phasing Strike.
target: Sam paulisper “Phasing Strike” aspexit.

source: “Ten percent True Damage!” he exclaimed in wonder.
target: “Decem centesimas verae laesionis!” exclamavit miratus.

source: Granted, there were defenses against True Damage, but against the common rabble, that skill was basically a death sentence.
target: Ita vero, defensionēs contra laesionem veram exstabant, sed contra vulgum plebem, illa peritia vere mors iudicabatur.

source: [Mana Disruption is now Level 3!]
target: [Perturbatio Manae nunc Gradus 3 est!]

source: [Mana Body Enhancement reached Level 21!]
target: [Amplificatio Corporis Manae ad Gradum 21 pervenit!]

source: [Thanks to the continuous usage of Mana Body Enhancement, you gained the sub‑skill Mana Influenced Body!]
target: [Gratias continuae usus Amplificationis Corporis Manae, subperitiam “Corpus Manae Influentis” adeptus es!]

source: [Mana Influenced Body: Level 0/10 (0%) (Passive) The mana running through your body enhances your physical attributes passively. +1% to STR, DEX, AGI, END per skill level.]
target: [Corpus Manae Influentis: Gradus 0/10 (0%) (Passiva) Mana per corpus tuum fluens, virtutes physicas tuas passim auget. +1% ad STR, DEX, AGI, END pro quolibet gradu peritiae.]

source: A nice but limited skill, still Sam was happy.
target: Peritia pulchra sed limitata, tamen Sam laetus erat.

source: The skills he gained during the fight were well worth the exertion.
target: Peritiae quas in pugna adeptus erat, labore suo valde dignae erant.

source: [Discernment is now Level 5!]
target: [Perspicitas nunc Gradus 5 est!]

source: [Intermediate Sword Mastery is now Level 11!]
target: [Peritia Gladii Intermedia nunc Gradus 11 est!]

source: [Stable Stance is now Level 5!]
target: [Stabilis Habitus nunc Gradus 5 est!]

source: [Thanks to handling the sword against a multitude of opponents successfully, you gained the sub‑skill Freeform Defense!]
target: [Gratias gladium contra multitudinem adversariorum feliciter tractandi, subperitiam “Defensio Liberae Forma” adeptus es!]

source: [Freeform Defense: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) When defending with your sword or parrying, you increase your accuracy and decrease the chance for a blowback.]
target: [Defensio Liberae Forma: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Cum gladio tuo defendis aut paries facis, accuratiam auges et casum repulsionis minues.]

source: [Intermediate Breathing Technique is now Level 3!]
target: [Technica Respirandi Intermedia nunc Gradus 3 est!]

source: [Calm Heart is now Level 17!]
target: [Cor Tranquillum nunc Gradus 17 est!]

source: [Flow is now Level 7!]
target: [Fluxus nunc Gradus 7 est!]

source: [Multitasking is now Level 44!]
target: [Multiplex Opera nunc Gradus 44 est!]

source: [Efficiency is now Level 6!]
target: [Efficientia nunc Gradus 6 est!]

source: Then came the skills from the Shadow skill tree.
target: Deinde peritiae ex arbore peritiarum Umbrarum apparuerunt.

source: If Sam was honest, he was the most excited about these.
target: Sam, sincero animo, de his maxime excitatus erat.

source: After all, they were the basis of his future build.
target: Nimirum, fundamentum futuri eius conformationis erant.

source: The Shadows were perfect for covert operations while also holding several high‑damage skills that were capable of devastating entire groups if used correctly.
target: Umbrae aptissimae erant ad operationes occultas, atque praeterea continentes plurimas peritias laesionis magnarum, quae totos coetus, si rite adhibitae, dirimere poterant.

source: Not to mention several lesser‑known aspects of the magic…
target: Nisi etiam nonnulla aspecta magica, minus nota, mentione habenda sunt…

source: Sam had big plans for those aspects.
target: Sam magnos consilia pro his aspectibus habebat.

source: [Shadow Cloak is now Level 10!]
target: [Pallium Umbrarum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Shadow Footwork is now Level 10!]
target: [Agilitas Pedum Umbrarum nunc Gradus 10 est!]

source: [Thanks to you integrating the skill almost perfectly into your arsenal, you gained the sub‑skill, Shadow Cover!]
target: [Gratias quod peritiam fere perfecte in armamentarium tuum integravisti, subperitiam “Umbram Tegentem” adeptus es!]

source: [Shadow Cover: Level 0/5 (0%) (Passive) When covered by shadow or darkness, be it natural or artificial, the effectiveness of the skill is increased by 10% for every level.]
target: [Umbram Tegentem: Gradus 0/5 (0%) (Passiva) Cum te umbra aut tenebris— sive naturalibus sive artificialibus— tegende, efficacia peritiae pro quolibet gradu decem centesimas augetur.]

source: [Shadow Burst has reached Level 3!]
target: [Explosio Umbrarum ad Gradum 3 pervenit!]

source: Sam spent a few minutes going over his new and old skills, making sure to compare them to his inherited memories and to make sure that his plan going forward was still viable.
target: Sam paucis minutis novas et veteres peritias recensuit, attendens eas ad memorias hereditarias comparare et cur eius consilium futurum adhuc valeat.

source: Satisfied with his gains, he stood up and began going over his equipment.
target: Sua lucri contentus, surrexit et apparatum suum percontari coepit.

source: He exchanged the sword for another one, as he was pretty sure that after overloading it with mana it was on its last legs.
target: Gladium pro alio commutavit, cum satis certus esset postquam eum mana oneratum, ad extremas vires redire.

source: “Can’t wait for the time when I can buy swords made from mana metals!”
target: “Non possum expectare tempus quo gladios ex metallis mana confectos emere possim!”

source: After making sure that his equipment was in order and that Lucky got a sufficient amount of pats on his head, he spoke up.
target: Postquam certus fuit apparatum suum ordinatum esse et Lucky satis de capite pulsatus habere, locutus est.

source: “Lucky, back into the shadow. We are going forward!”
target: “Lucky, rede ad umbram. Progredimur!”

source: He was answered by an excited bark, and Lucky jumped into the air and dived directly into his shadow.
target: Responsum ei datum est latratu excitato, et Lucky in aethera saliit atque directe in suam umbram conclusus est.

source: The corridor after leaving the chamber with the two golems was suspiciously empty.
target: Corridor, postquam cellam cum duobus golemis reliquit, insidiose vacuus erat.

source: He wasn’t besieged by golems dripping miasma, or roaring at him.
target: Non circumdatus erat golemis miasma stillantibus aut ad eum rugientes.

source: The only thing he could hear as he tried to ghost through the corridor was the dripping of water and his own breath.
target: Unum solum, quod audire poterat dum per corridor transeundus esset, erat stillatio aquae et proprius spiritus.

source: To chase away the darkness he summoned his new Light Ball spell, changing the color to red to protect his eyes.
target: Ut tenebras fugeret, novam incantationem “Orbis Lucis” evocavit, colorem ad rubrum mutans ut oculos defenderet.

source: Finally, after a few minutes of overly cautious walking, he could see the light at the end of the tunnel.
target: Denique, post paucas minutis ambulandi nimis cauti, lucem in fine cuniculi videre potuit.

source: The red light of the spell slowly gave away at the light that was appearing in the distance.
target: Ruber lumen incantationis lente cederet luce, quae in longinquo appareret.

source: He hastened his walking a little, but his sword was still raised in a defensive position, ready for any sneak attack, giving the ceiling a glance every few feet.
target: Celerius ambulare conatus est, sed gladium suum in positione defensionis attulit, paratum ad incursiones furtivas, et inter singulos pedum intervalla tectum intuens.

source: As he reached the origin of the light, Sam dismissed his own Light Ball and stepped into the illuminated chamber.
target: Cum ad originem luminis pervenisset, Sam suum “Orbem Lucis” dimisit et in cellam illuminatam ingressus est.

source: It was a small room, containing nothing more than a giant stone door with three small holes in the relief and several stone torches lit up by ethereal white flames.
target: Parva cella erat, nihil amplius continens quam ianuam lapideam ingentem cum tribus foraminibus parvis in bas-relievo et compluras lucernas lapideas, a flammis aetheriis albis accensas.

source: The artwork on the door was a giant tree whose roots surrounded a giant ball and based on the symbols, the ball was radiating light.
target: Opus in ianua depictum erat: ingens arbor, cuius radices globum ingentem circumdonabant, et secundum symbola, globus lucem emanabat.

source: At least, that is how it looked to Sam.
target: Saltem, ita Sam videbatur.

source: The three small holes were on the trunk of the tree carved into the door, lined up vertically.
target: Tres parva foramina erant in truncu arboris in ianua sculpti, verticaliter disposita.

source: Sam didn’t need much prompting.
target: Sam parum exhortationis egit.

source: He retrieved the small shining marbles from his inventory and, one by one, inserted them into the holes in the door and took a big step backward.
target: Parvos lucentes marmoribus ex inventario suo extraxit et, uno post alium, in foramina ianuae inseruit atque magnum gradum retrorsum fecit.

source: He saw too many adventure films to fall into one of these…
target: Vidit nimis pelliculas adventurales ut in talem casum incidere evitarent.

source: The moment the last marble was inserted, it started shining much stronger, the stone torches also flaring and originating from the three marbles, a vertical line of light bisected the door.
target: Mox, cum ultimum marmor inserta est, incipiebat multo fortius fulgere; et faces lapideae ex tribus marmoreis oriundae, linea lucis verticalis ianuam secabant.

source: Though nothing else happened.
target: Attamen, nihil aliud evenit.

source: Sighing a little, Sam stepped forward and gave the doors a push.
target: Paululum suspirans, Sam in antecessum processit et ianuas impulsit.

source: With intense groaning and making noises that would wake the dead, the stone door swung inward, shaking the room a little and showering Sam once again with dust.
target: Cum intensis gemitu et sonis qui mortuos excitare posnerent, ianuam lapideam intus oscillare coepit, cellam paulo concussit et Sam iterum cum pulvere infudit.

source: Shaking off the majority of the dust, sword raised high, defensive skills engaged, and his other hand shining with restrained magic that was ready to be released at the first sign of trouble, Sam stepped into the room.
target: Plerumque pulveris avulsis, gladio alto sublato, peritia defensionis activata, et altera manu magia moderata fulgente, parata ad primo discrimine emittendum, Sam in cellam ingressus est.

source: Thankfully, this chamber was also illuminated by the same stone torches.
target: Gratias, haec cella quoque eadem facularum lapidearum luce illustrata erat.

source: Though this time the flames were tainted by flecks and streaks of darkness.
target: Sed hoc tempore flammas maculae et striae tenebrarum deturpebant.

source: Inside the room was the same thing depicted on the door.
target: Intra cellam idem erat quod in ianua depictum fuit.

source: Just, the entire thing was wrong…
target: Verumtamen, totum recte non conveniebat…

source: The ceiling high up was covered by darkness which was occasionally illuminated by the flickering torches.
target: Tectum alte superiectum tenebris erat, quae interdum micantibus facularum luce illuminabatur.

source: In front of him was a giant ironwood tree carved from stone, the roots an intricate artwork.
target: Ante eum stabat ingens arbor ex ferro ligno sculpta in lapide, cuius radices intricato opere expressae erant.

source: As the artwork on the door depicted it, the roots were enveloping a giant ball of light.
target: Sicut opus in ianua depictum erat, radices globum ingentem lucis complectebantur.

source: The difference between the artwork and reality was that there was the familiar miasma dropping down, like water droplets, from the ceiling.
target: Differentia inter opus et rem constat in eo quod miasma notum, sicut guttas aquae, ex tectu stillabat.

source: They ran down on the bark of the carved tree, finishing their journey by falling on the ball of light, tainting it.
target: In cortice arboris sculptae defluebant, iter absoluentes cadentes in globum lucis atque eum maculantes.

source: Under the ball of light that was almost halfway converted into miasma was a pool of the same miasma, churning and bubbling.
target: Sub globo lucis, qui paene ad dimidium miasma conversus erat, erant piscinae eodem miasma, bullientes et ferventes.

source: As Sam examined it with his Mana Sight, he couldn't help but describe the entire situation as evil.
target: Dum Sam eam per Visum Magi perspexit, non potuit non totam rem mala describere.

source: He barely had the time to take all of this in, as the moment he stepped through the archway a curtain of white flames tainted by black light sprung up behind, locking him into the chamber and the bubbling pool of miasma gave a shuddering breath by way of a giant bubble and began to rise.
target: Vix tempus habuit totum hoc percipere; simul ac per arcum ingrediebatur, velum flammarum albarum nigro lumine tinctum subit, eum in cellam claudens; et piscina miasmatum bulliens, per ingentem bullam tremulum spiritum emittens, sursum crescere coepit.

source: And rise.
target: Et ascendit.

source: And rise up high.
target: Et alte ascendit.

source: In a few seconds, what stood in front of Sam was a giant golem made from the miasma from the now empty pool with a few rocks and stones in its body.
target: In paucis secundis, quod ante Sam stabat, erat ingens golem ex miasma piscinae iam vacua factus, cum paucis saxis et lapidibus in corpore suo.

source: Sam scowled a little because a sludge‑type golem required different skills to defeat than a golem made from solid materials.
target: Sam paulum ore contristatus erat, quia golem generis luti alias peritias ad vincendum requirabat quam golem ex materiis solidis factus.

source: It didn’t even have the courtesy of having a giant glowing orb that Sam could target easily.
target: Neque tamen habebat comitatem ingentis orbis lucentis, quem Sam facile intendere posset.

source: But Sam was a gamer, and he had fought sludge‑type golems thousands, maybe even a million times in different games.
target: Sed Sam lusor erat, et contra golemata luti numerosis, fortasse etiam milionibus vicibus in variis ludis pugnaverat.

source: So, while the controlling intelligence behind the miasma had caused him some trouble, it was not the end of the road.
target: Ita, quamvis intelligentia imperans miasma eum aliqua incommoda attulerit, finis viae non erat.

source: Granted, this entire thing would have been easier with a team of people, but he had come so far alone, he might as well finish it.
target: Certo, totum hoc facilius fuisset cum turma hominum, sed solus tam longe progressus erat ut id perficeret.

source: He didn’t have much time as the monster roared and with it came a giant stream of miasma aimed directly at Sam.
target: Paucum temporis habebat, cum monstrum rugivit et eo una ingens fluxus miasma, directe in Sam destinatus, progressus est.

source: Sam, ready for the attack, raised his left hand and unleashed his own mana opposite of the stream of rapidly approaching miasma.
target: Sam, ad impetum paratus, manum sinistram attoluit et mana sua adversus flumen miasma celeriter appropinquantis effudit.

source: The two streams met in the middle of the chamber, oozing darkness clashing with the pale blue of Sam’s mana.
target: Duae undae in medio cellae convenerunt, tenebra fluentes cum caeruleo pallido mana Sam confractantes.

source: Thankfully, this gave Sam enough time to review the situation.
target: Gratias, hoc Sam satis temporis dedit ut condicionem percontaret.

source: “I don’t have any fire spell strong enough to burn it away and I doubt I could cut it up into enough pieces before I run out of mana.”
target: “Nullam incantationem ignis satis validam habeo ut id comburerim neque fereor an id in satis frusta secare possim antequam mana deficiat.”

source: Looking down at his feet at the smooth rock, he had an idea.
target: Pedibus in saxo laeve intuentibus, ideam accepit.

source: “But I have runes…”
target: “Sed habeo runas…”

source: Pointing his sword down at the front of his feet, he began to move it slowly using mana to extend the cutting edge while carefully maintaining the stream of mana holding back the miasma.
target: Gladium suum ad pedum anteriora vertens, incipiebat lente movere, mana utens ad acuminis secandi extensionem faciendam, dum cura flumen mana miasma cohibens retinebat.

source: Though he made sure to play with the monster a little, pretending that his control slipped and letting the stream of miasma get closer to him.
target: Etsi certus fuit paulum cum monstro ludere, simulans imperium suum lapsum esse et flumen miasma propius accedere concessit.

source: The point was to make sure that the monster thought that they had him on the ropes while he carved his Heart Rune into the smooth stone floor.
target: Intentio erat ut monstrum existimaret se “in funiculo” esse, dum cor runam in laevo lapideo pavimento sculpere contendebat.

source: While he had no skills that could kill the damn monster, he knew the runes for purification and containment.
target: Dum nullas peritias habebat quae damnatum monstrum interficere possent, runas ad purificationem et continentiam noverat.

source: Building a basic rune circle would be rather easy based on the controlling intelligence, as it seemed to only change things after a fight, so it used the sludge‑type to counter the skills that Sam had shown off so far.
target: Circulum runarum fundamentalem condere facillimum esset, secundum intelligentiam imperantem, cum videbatur res solum post pugnam mutare; ideo genus luti ad peritias quas Sam usque ostenderat oppositum habebat.

source: Rookie mistake, but one that Sam would capitalize on.
target: Error puerilis, sed quem Sam ad lucrum exquirere potuit.

source: Finishing the rune, he threw a glance at the golem that was still roaring at him; the miasma leaving his mouth in a stream, like vomit in a frat house during a home game.
target: Runa conficiens, oculum in golem, qui adhuc ad eum rugiebat, iacuit; miasma ex ore eius fluens, quasi vomitus in domo sodalium ludi domestici, effluens.

source: With a quick countdown, he cut off his own mana stream and instantly dodged to the right, letting the miasma splash with a hissing noise against the flame‑curtain, locking him into the chamber.
target: Celeriter numerans, flumen mana suum evellit et statim ad dextrum subsiluit, sinens miasma cum sibilo adversus velum flammarum dispersi, eum in cellam claudens.

source: Taking a few steps, he peppered the monster with a flurry of Wind Blades.
target: Paucis gradibus processit, et monstrum seriem laminarum venti iaculari confregit.

source: Using his newest skill the only thing it did was cut into the miasma which parted like jello and instantly fused back together.
target: Nova peritia utens, tantum id fecit ut in miasma incidens, quod quasi gelatina disrumpit atque statim se iterum coalescere inceperet.

source: But Sam wanted the monster to concentrate on the attacks it had already seen and not on what he was doing on the floor.
target: Sed Sam volebat ut monstrum in impetibus, quos iam vidisset, intenderet, et non in id quod ipse in pavimento faceret.

source: Fortunately, the chamber was circular so Sam didn't have to go far, keeping his Heart Rune in his view, to begin carving his next rune.
target: Fortunate, cella circulare erat, ergo Sam longe ire non debebat, cor runam in conspectu servans, ut proximam runam sculpere inciperet.

source: The monster meanwhile stopped its projectile vomiting and turned towards him, staying in the middle of the room.
target: Interim, monstrum vomitum proiectile cessavit et ad eum conversum est, in medio cellae manens.

source: However, instead of the monster releasing another projectile at him, it spoke, causing Sam to jump a little.
target: Attamen, pro eo quod monstrum alium proiectile in eum dimitteret, locutum est, quod Sam paulum salire fecit.

source: Luckily, he wasn’t carving at the moment of the jump, so the rune wasn’t ruined.
target: Fortunate, non runam sculpere tempore salitus incumbebat, ita ut runa non corrupta esset.

source: “INTRUDER!”
target: “INTRUSUS!”

source: The voice came out hoarse with ominous bubbling in the background as if it was coming from a deep, dark hole.
target: Vox rauca exortus est cum bullientibus sonis ominosis in fundo, velut ex fovea profunda et obscura.

source: Sam, knowing that talking with mysterious entities was never the best idea, just looked at it, while his sword hand was continuing the drawing with him, occasionally glancing down to make sure he was doing it correctly.
target: Sam, sciens loqui cum entitatibus arcanais numquam optimum consilium esse, simpliciter illud aspiciens mansit, dum manus gladii eius delineationem prosequebatur et intermisso oculo deorsum intuens cur recte ageret.

source: Thankfully, the basic runes were simple to draw…
target: Gratias, runae fundamentales simplices erant ad delineandum…

source: “BEFOULER!” Came another roar.
target: “IMPURUS!” exclamavit alter rugitus.

source: Then another.
target: Deinde alterum.

source: “ENEMY!”
target: “HOSTIS!”

source: Having finished the rune, Sam’s answer was another barrage of wind blades directly aimed at the mouth of the golem.
target: Runa finita, responsio Sam alteram seriem laminarum venti directe in os golematis intendentem fuit.

source: The response was pretty predictable.
target: Responsio satis praevisibilis fuit.

source: With a harsh cry of “DIE!” the monster released another stream of miasma at him.
target: Cum aspero clamore “MORI!” monstrum alium fluxum miasma in eum dimittere coepit.

source: This time he didn’t try to counter it, he simply sidestepped it and continued to the next position to begin carving the next rune.
target: Hoc tempore illud repellere conatus non est; sed eam in latere praecurrit et ad proximam positionem processit ut runam sequentem sculpere inciperet.

source: This time the golem and the intelligence behind it seemed to realize that Sam was fast enough to dodge the miasma stream.
target: Hoc tempore golem et intelligentia eius videbantur intellexisse Sam satis celeri esse ut fluxum miasma devinqueret.

source: So, the moment Sam stopped, it raised both of its hands and once again opened its mouth.
target: Ita, quo Sam subsistebat, golem uterque manu attoluit et iterum os aperuit.

source: However, instead of a continuous stream of dark ooze it started spitting bullets of the disgusting material at Sam.
target: Attamen, pro continuo fluxu obscuri luti, globulos materiae foedae in Sam iaculari incipiebat.

source: Sam simply tapped the ground with his foot and raised a curved Earth Wall in front of him, reinforced with his mana.
target: Sam pede terram tetigit et murum Terrae curvam ante se attoluit, mana suo corroboratum.

source: While that cut off his sight, his other senses allowed him to see where the monster was aiming or what it was doing.
target: Dum hoc visum eius abstulit, cetera sensus eum permitterunt videre quo monstrum intendebat vel quid faceret.

source: Seeing the wall rise, the beast roared again.
target: Murum oriente videns, bestia iterum rugivit.

source: “DARKNESS WILL CONSUME YOU!”
target: “TENEBRAE TE DEVORABUNT!”

source: And the barrage of miasma missiles intensified on his Earth Wall.
target: Et agmen miasmatum telorum super Murum Terrae eius intensum factum est.

source: “Oh boy, one of those…” Sam mumbled as he finished carving the third rune.
target: “O puer, unum ex iis…” Sam submurmuravit dum tertiam runam sculpsit.

source: Upon finishing it, he refocused his attention on the barrage and did another quick assessment, not wanting to get hit by the miasma despite his improved Mana Shield.
target: Postquam eam finivit, animum suum in agmina redemit et aliam celerem aestimationem fecit, ne miasma, quamvis Scutum Manae emendatum haberet, percuteretur.

source: He channeled a little more mana into the Earth Wall, protecting him.
target: Paululum plus mana in Murum Terrae infudit, eum protegens.

source: And then exploded it at the monster.
target: Et deinde illud in monstrum concussit.

source: This paused the miasma barrage, allowing him to continue his journey around the stone sculpture and golem while the body of the monster swallowed the debris and made its own.
target: Hoc agmen miasmatum intermisit, quo facto eum permisit ut iter circa sculpturam lapideam et golem pergeret, dum corpus monstri ruinas devorabat et suas partes conficiebat.

source: The moment he found a nice place to carve his rune, another wall rose in front of him, protecting him from the renewed barrage that seemed to be cracking the wall with every impact, causing him to spend mana to repair it.
target: Mox cum locum iucundum invenit ad runam sculpere, alter murus ante eum oriebatur, eum ab agmine renovato protegens, qui, singulis ictibus murum fissionem faciens, eam reparare mana impendere cogebat.

source: It only took a second for Sam to realize that the golem was using the rocks in its body to enhance the projectiles.
target: Solum uno momento Sam intellexit golem ut saxa in corpore suo ad telorum augendum denudaret.

source: “BEFOULER!”
target: “IMPURUS!”

source: Meanwhile, the monster kept his very stimulating commentary up.
target: Interim, monstrum commentarium suum valde excitantem servavit.

source: Sam didn’t dare to drop his concentration for even a second, no matter how much he wanted to slap his face with his palm.
target: Sam ne quidem attentionem dimittere ausus est, quamvis vehementer vultum manu percutere vellebat.

source: Dying right now would set the quest back enough that he would need an entire team to get back to the same position thanks to the monster learning from fights.
target: Morte nunc, re vera, quaestionem satis retardaret ut totam turmam ad eandem positionem redeundam haberet, ob monstrum ex pugnis discens.

source: “DIE!”
target: “MORI!”

source: Ignoring the monster, he reinforced the wall even more and tried to finish the rune as fast as possible.
target: Monstrum ignorans, murum etiam magis corroboravit et conatus est runam quam celerrime conficere.

source: After finishing the fourth rune, the fifth was the same.
target: Postquam quartam runam finivit, quintae idem erant.

source: The miasma golem kept shooting miasma bullets mixed with rock pieces from the exploded Earth Wall at him.
target: Golem miasmaticus perpétuo telis miasmaticis mixtis fragminibus saxorum ex Muris Terrae concussis in eum iaculari pergebat.

source: However, the moment he headed for the sixth one, the controlling intelligence realized that he could keep the Earth Wall intact during the barrage and changed its approach, which turned into a charge.
target: Attamen, momento quo ad sextam runam processit, intelligentia imperans intellexit eum Murum Terrae intactum tenere posse in agmine miasmatico et consilium mutavit, quod in impetum versa est.

source: That is the monster decided to charge at his wall.
target: Id indicat monstrum constituisse in murum eius impetum facere.

source: Panicking a little, Sam channeled more mana into the Earth Wall, increasing both its height and width.
target: Paululum perterruit, Sam plus mana in Murum Terrae infudit, altitudinem atque latitudinem eius augens.

source: The golem smashed against it with a thundering plop, miasma splashing everywhere.
target: Golem illud cum tonitruculo percussit, miasma ubique dispergens.

source: Sam quickly finished the sixth rune, and as the miasma monster began to ooze around the obstacle, he exploded at it again.
target: Sam celeriter sextam runam finivit, et cum monstrum miasmaticum circa obstaculum exundare coepit, iterum in illud concussit.

source: Despite jumping backward at the same time the detonation went off, he was still splashed with enough frothing miasma that the first layer of his Mana Shield practically vanished into the ether.
target: Quamquam simul retrorsum saliit cum detonatio accidit, tamen sufficiens miasma ebulliens eum aspergebat ut primum stratum Scuti Manae fere in aetherem evanuerit.

source: Luckily for him, the golem was practically enveloping the wall when it exploded, so it was partly scattered.
target: Fortunate, golem murum fere complectebatur cum concusserat, ita ut partes eius dispersae sint.

source: This allowed Sam to use the time it brought its body back together to finish the seventh and eighth runes, almost reaching the final spot on the right of the first rune, his Heart Rune.
target: Hoc Sam concessit ut tempore quo corpus golem congregabatur, septimam et octavum runas conficeret, paene ad locum ultimum ad dextram primae runae, cor runae eius, perveniens.

source: The entire chamber was peppered with the exploded remains of his Earth Walls and small pools of miasma were everywhere on the ground, hanging from the wall and covering almost everything.
target: Tota cella erat sparsa reliquiis explosarum Murorum Terrae eius, et parvae piscinae miasmatum ubique in solo erant, ex muro pendentes et fere omnia tegens.

source: By the time Sam reached the last position, for the ninth rune for this very basic rune circle, the golem had pulled itself together, accompanied by a rather pleasant shrieking.
target: Cum Sam ad ultimum locum pervenisset, ad novem runam huius circuli fundamentalis, golem se congregaverat, comitatus iucundo stridore.

source: “ENEMY!”
target: “HOSTIS!”

source: “BEFOULER!”
target: “IMPURUS!”

source: “YOU WILL BE CONSUMED!”
target: “TE DEVORABUNT!”

source: “DARKNESS WILL PREVAIL!”
target: “TENEBRAE PRAEVALEBUNT!”

source: As always, Sam just ignored it and began to carve the last rune, the rune that would close the circle and connect everything together.
target: Ut semelso, Sam id ignoravit et ultimam runam sculpere coepit, runam quae circulum claudere atque omnia coniungere posset.

source: The monster immediately began to charge at him and, raising its arms, it also began shooting balls of miasma at him.
target: Monstrum statim in eum impetum facere coepit et brachia tollens, globos miasmaticos in eum iaculari incipiebat.

source: Scowling at it, Sam raised several walls between himself and the monster, not caring about their quality, just that they held off the golem long enough for him to finish the rune.
target: Ocre vultu, Sam plura muros inter se et monstrum attoluit, qualitate non curans, solum id quod golem satis diu retardaret ut runam conficeret.

source: “YOU WILL BE DESTROYED!”
target: “TE DELEBUNT!”

source: The golem simply enveloped the wall that rose up next to it and smashed the following one with a rock engulfed in miasma.
target: Golem simpliciter murum, qui iuxta eum oriebatur, complectens, sequentem lapide, miasmate involuto, confractus est.

source: But Sam kept creating walls, and it kept the golem slow enough that he could finish the rune.
target: Sed Sam muros creare perseveravit, et hoc golem satis tardavit ut runam conficere posset.

source: The rune glowed briefly with a pale blue light, showing that the circle was completed correctly, causing Sam to grin up at the golem that was leaning over him, arms stretched, ready to envelop him into the miasma.
target: Runa breviter luce caerulea pallida fulgebat, ostendens circulum recte confectum esse, quod Sam subridens ad golem, qui super eum se inclinabat, brachiis extendentibus, paratus eum in miasma complectere, intuebatur.

source: Sam was pretty sure not even his Mana Shield would protect him then from the dangerous ooze.
target: Sam satis certus erat ne Scutum Manae quidem eum tunc a periculoso luto protegere posset.

source: Luckily, he had a nifty little skill.
target: Fortunate, habebat parvam peritiam ingeniosam.

source: “Shadow Burst!”
target: “Explosio Umbrarum!”

source: He launched himself away from the golem that had smashed down to the ground where he was a moment before like a dark and foul tidal wave.
target: Se a golem, qui paulo ante in terram concusum fuerat, sicut unda alta obscura atque foeda, proiecit.

source: With a few powerful strides, he arrived back at the first position, where he engraved his Heart Rune into the floor, and as the golem gathered itself together, he called out to Lucky.
target: Paucis stridulis potentibus, ad primum locum reversus est, ubi cor runam suam in pavimento inscripsit, et dum golem se congregabat, Lucky vocavit.

source: “Lucky, launch it towards the center!”
target: “Lucky, illum ad centrum proice!”

source: He received no verbal response to his order.
target: Nullam responsionem verbalem praecepto suo accepit.

source: Although, the moment he finished said order, Lucky jumped out of the shadow that danced on the wall thanks to the weird lighting.
target: Tamen, simul ac praeceptum finivit, Lucky ex umbra, quae in muro saltabat ob insolitam lucem, exsiluit.

source: The loyal wolf, then like a shadowy bullet, impacted the golem.
target: Fidelis lupus, dein quasi glans umbratica, golem percussit.

source: Sam was happy to see that the shadows coiling around Lucky affected the spirit within and thus the whole golem, ignoring its liquid body.
target: Sam laetus erat quod umbrae circa Lucky implicatae spiritum intimum commoverent atque ita totum golem, corpus liquidum oblitterans, afficere videbantur.

source: The golem was launched back towards its origin point, not far enough to get it back to the center, but it was enough for Sam that it was fully in the circle.
target: Golem retrorsum ad punctum originis proiectus est, non satis prope ad centrum redeundum, sed Sam satis habebat quod plene in circulo erat.

source: Waiting for Lucky to land outside of the circle, he grinned triumphantly.
target: Exspectans ut Lucky extra circulum terram attingeret, triumphanter subridens fuit.

source: Slamming his hand down on his Heart Rune just as the miasma golem reoriented itself and exclaimed,
target: Manum suam in cor runam contundens, simul ac golem miasmaticus se reorientavit, exclamavit:

source: “Activate!”
target: “Agite!”
